verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is self-hosted and stores agent memory as plain Markdown files in the local workspace and session history in SQLite, meaning a user's data lives on their own machine in accessible, largely open formats rather than being locked in a vendor cloud. However, there is no documented explicit 'export all data' feature, migration tool, or guidance for fully extracting/leaving with all state (e.g., secrets, channel configs, skills) in a single open-format bundle. Missing for 10: explicit data-export/migration tooling, documentation confirming all state (not just memory) is portable, and independent confirmation of successful full data extraction.
